title: SPECIAL: Nick Devlin and Elliot Turner on the Business Model of Naked Wines
summary: RGA Investment Advisors runs a long-term, low turnover, growth at a reasonable price investment strategy seeking out global opportunities. Since then, Nick has led Naked through a rapidly evolving operational and customer environment to deliver a step change in growth in 2020.

reader_summary.headline: Elliot Turner, Managing Partner and Chief Investment Officer of RGA Investment Advisors, and Nick Devlin.
reader_summary.overview: Elliot Turner, Managing Partner and Chief Investment Officer of RGA Investment Advisors, and Nick Devlin, Chief Executive Officer of Naked Wines (UK: WINE). Elliot and Nick discussed the evolution and business model of Naked Wines and explored the topic, “Driving Customer Value via Scale Economies Shared”. The primary purpose of this podcast is to educate and inform.
